whatsNew.title: What’s Different From 2025–26
content: The first student day moves one day earlier, from August 13 to August 12.
The scheduled last day moves from May 22 to May 27.
The student-day total increases from 172 to 173.
Spring Break moves one week later, from March 9–13 to March 15–19.
Christmas Break begins one day earlier, on December 21, while students still return January 6.
March 26 is a student holiday. March 29 is also listed as a holiday but may be used as an inclement-weather make-up day.

comparisonFooterText: Dates are based on each district’s published 2026–27 calendar. District labels and adjacent staff dates may differ.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Conroe ISD start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Conroe ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Students are released early, and the fourth grading period ends that day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Conroe ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Conroe ISD Christmas Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Christmas Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 5, 2027. Students return Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Conroe ISD have a fall break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Conroe ISD does not label a dedicated Fall Break. The official calendar lists October 9–12 as a holiday, and students return Tuesday, October 13.

calendarFaqs.q: Is March 26, 2027 a Conroe ISD school holiday?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Conroe ISD lists Friday, March 26, 2027 as a student holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens on March 29, 2027 in Conroe ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: March 29 is listed as a student holiday and reserved as an inclement-weather make-up day. Students are off unless Conroe ISD uses the date to replace lost instructional time. Check district announcements before making plans for that day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are December 18 and May 27 early-release days in Conroe ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar lists student early release on Friday, December 18, 2026 and Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official Conroe ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link above for Conroe ISD’s approved calendar. The separate MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the Conroe ISD calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The approved one-page calendar was checked for student start and end dates, holidays, breaks, early releases, grading-period endings, and the March 29 footnote.
Conroe ISD lists March 26 as a holiday and March 29 as a holiday reserved for use as a student and staff inclement-weather make-up day if needed.
The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically if Conroe ISD activates March 29 or revises the calendar.
Campus events, bell schedules, athletics, testing, and emergency announcements are outside this districtwide calendar’s scope.
